title: Boolean input encoding identity
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, and let $z$ assign an element of $[?]$ to each of its $1+n+g$ coordinates. Identify $	ext{false}$ with $0$ and $	ext{true}$ with $1$ in the field $[?]$. For every input index $i$, encoding the Boolean value obtained by decoding the coordinate of $z$ assigned to input $i$ recovers that coordinate.
